statement: The monodromy of the eight ordinary circles tangent to three labelled general circles is the inner holomorph D₈ ⋊ Inn(D₈), where D₈ denotes the dihedral group of order 8. It has order 32 and GAP identifier SmallGroup(32,49).

answer.qualification: The explicit group was inspected in Zeng’s 2025 expository derivation, which attributes the result to Harris (1982); Harris’s original text was inaccessible. Do not confuse this group with McKean’s set-theoretic (C₂)^3 duality action or with the group after base change to chosen radii.

scope: Labelled input circles parameterized by their ordinary conic coefficients, without adjoining chosen square roots of their squared radii.
